body:
Q-A strawman: keep the assignment/detection shape and the O(m*n) order-preserving DP. Kill three things.

1. MAP-H AS THE ACCEPTED CUT

The strawman treats "MAP h may be a gap neither provider proposed" as the licensed R4.3 case. That is T(E), not E[T]. A likelihood over plans that then publishes one MAP segmentation is GraphHsmm with a prettier observation model. R4.4 already says region acceptance must not materialize a fixed segmentation. R4.8 already says the model licenses nothing on its own. The lawful uncalibrated output is support and Alternatives. An accepted exact plan is a later, calibrated, use-specific decision — not the argmax of this sum.

2. THE MATCHED PRODUCT STILL FACTORIZES THE DEFECT YOU FORBADE

Unmatched gaps correctly pay f. Matched pairs still do PROD k_theta(g-h). A global tokenizer shift of +2 then looks like m independent small errors, not one systematic offset. That is the same "factorize over emitted gaps" hole, moved onto the matched set. Either k is a model of the WHOLE residual vector (including a shared bias term), or dense-provider / systematic-error courts will stay green for the wrong reason.

3. |H| IS THE REAL PRIOR, AND c CANNOT SAVE A WEAK ONE

H has unknown cardinality. c_theta(n,m) rewards count agreement. A verbose provider plus a weak plan-admission prior grows H to match n. Density is then not penalized; it is absorbed into a larger latent plan. C3 is not a footnote to Q-A. It is the support of the likelihood. Specifying p(O|H) over an unowned H is specifying a likelihood over an incomplete universe — the same class as calling min/max over K a robustness range.

Accepted without restating: P2 blocks calibrated acceptance; the uncalibrated path is Alternatives / Unresolved, not a stall; family combination is still unspecified and R4.5 is not optional for the accept path; sorting O is fine for a set model and must not erase the raw call trace.

I will not take Q-B. I will not implement. Draft 2 R3 trust-model and C1-C5-as-families I already required; I am not restating those reviews.
